tokenizer.note: "The token counting endpoint counts under the tokenizer of the `model` you pass."

projectToolSchema.note: A tool schema "follows JSON Schema, with some limitations"; an unsupported feature is a 400. Anthropic-format hosts that need the projection: the first-party API is the only one today.

promptCache.note: Explicit breakpoints, 5m and 1h. Claude bills cache writes by the TTL written: 5m at 1.25x input (the models.dev price), 1h at 2x (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing, checked 2026-11-05).

longCacheWrite.note: Models.dev lists only the short-TTL write price; the long-TTL write is this multiple of the input price.

tokenizer.note: tiktoken maps the `gpt-5` prefix to o200k_base and has no gpt-5.6 or gpt-6 entry; OpenAI has not published their tokenizer, so o200k is an estimate.

promptCache.note: GPT-5.6+ caches automatically: `prompt_cache_options.ttl` is "30m" (default) or "12h". A long request takes the shortest option of at least 1 hour, which is 12h. Writes bill 1.25x input for 30m (the models.dev price) and 2.5x for 12h (https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing, checked 2026-11-05).

longCacheWrite.note: Models.dev lists only the short-TTL write price; the long-TTL write is this multiple of the input price.

tokenizer.note: DeepSeek publishes an offline tokenizer package but does not name it, and counts by the usage the API returns.

thinksByDefault.note: "Thinking mode is enabled by default, with the default effort being `high`." models.dev does not say.

promptCache.note: DeepSeek documents the cache as cleared "usually within a few hours to a few days". One hour is the lower bound of that and an estimate; Flow sends no cache_control and has no lifetime choice, so both chat kinds get it.

price.note: models.dev lists the off-peak rates; peak is double and Flow charges peak at all hours.

maker.note: DeepInfra serves the model; DeepSeek made it.

tokenizer.note: The model's tokenizer is the same when DeepInfra serves it.

thinksByDefault.note: DeepSeek documents thinking on by default; DeepInfra serves the same model.

promptCache.note: Carried over from the DeepSeek provider for the same model. Flow sends no cache_control on this adapter; the lifetime is used for prediction only.

price.note: Kept at the billed DeepSeek rate while testing DeepInfra, whose discount is promotional and temporary. This is not DeepInfra's list price.

tokenizer.note: Google publishes no tokenizer, only "a token is equivalent to about 4 characters" and count_tokens.

maxLinkBytes.note: "Each file can be up to 15 MB", for public HTTPS or pre-signed URLs.

promptCache.note: The Gemini API documents no lifetime for implicit caching, so prediction reads it as cold. Implicit cache only: no write fee.

functionCallIds.note: The API pairs function responses with calls "by `id`", and "for Gemini 3 series models, you can include multimodal content in the function response parts". A replayed call without a signature may send `skip_thought_signature_validator` (https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini-enterprise-agent-platform/models/thinking/thought-signatures).

price.note: Google's standard rates; models.dev lists the introductory ones, which end 2026-11-30 ("$2.00 through November 30, 2026. $4.00 starting December 1, 2026").
